measurement_note: Size is D, the number of decimal digits in n. Each false input has distinct digits, so a literal correct permutation search exhausts every arrangement before concluding that none equals the invariant factorial sum. The accepted digit-count method is O(D); the exhaustive control is O(D! * D).
